Lars used to be a police officer. Together with his wife Sandy and their young son, he moved from Germany to a remote Scottish island in the Atlantic.

Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you』ve seen. And it’s here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.
In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.
This episode explores Marilyn’s defiance about posing nude and how it catapults her to stardom.

This episode explores how Marilyn shows her mature talent as an actress and wins a triumphant victory over Twentieth Century Fox shortly before her untimely death.
It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.
The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.
The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.
In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

p.d: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

When the world is plunged into eternal darkness, adventurer Xiao Wu sets out to find a sealed ancient book that controls the universe. Betrayed by ruthless factions, he discovers he is a reincarnated magical page bound by an ancient love. Awakening his hidden powers, he battles evil to restore light and fulfil his destiny.

Erin, a troubled young woman with trauma and anger, travels to a remote estate to meet her boyfriend’s family. The visit turns into a nightmare when she discovers they are part of a blood cult. Abducted and marked for harvest, Erin unleashes a deadly rage, turning the hunt into a brutal fight for survival.

The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

Disorganisation is usually a weakness, but in the Australian animal kingdom it is the opposite. This episode explores how being DISORGANISED works in our fauna's favour. kookaburra families, flying fox colonies and Tasmanian devil broods all show how a chaotic approach to life can help a species get ahead in a land of extremes.

Pu Song Ling accidentally releases the Black Mountain Demon during his writing. A goddess fights the demon but her body is destroyed, leaving behind her spirit. She borrows the body of Pus wife to continue the fight but they get trapped by the Black Mountain Demon. To save his wife, Pu must touch another three demons heart.

A bride named Ru is the sole survivor of her familys massacre, and is rescued by a masked man. A year later, she learns from the newsmonger Bao that the massacre was orchestrated by a bandit who wants to avenges his fathers death caused by Rus father. With the help of Bao, Ru vanquishes the lackeys of the bandit and seeks her own vengeance.

The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love. However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day. Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

Three friends meet Shirley in Gu Lan County. They save a professor trapped in the Dragon Labyrinth, but two friends suffer from skin rashes after leaving the labyrinth. According to the notes written by Shirleys grandfather, the antidotes may be hidden at Tong Tian Buddhist Temple, so the four of them set off on a challenging journey for the cure.

Phoenix Island is attacked by a mutated object, causing people to mysteriously disappear and inducing panic. Top bird trainer Mao Shan Hao teams up with a security team leader to investigate the case. The search intensifies as they uncover clues linking the missing victims to zombies, adding a thrilling twist to the case.

Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

After a sudden explosion in the city, the anti-explosion team dashes to the scene to rescue and investigate. Led by Officer Ma and Officer Zhu, they prioritize peoples safety and set out to prevent further explosions. Tension mounts as the situation becomes increasingly volatile. Can the team defeat the odds and bring an end to the crisis?

Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

p.d: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…
